logic_errors.finding: Append and no-op saves verify only the durable prefix head, not its dependencies. They can publish an unreadable generation and rotate away the last readable recovery generation.
reproduction: Create a fresh seed-74 Tiny campaign with two factions and a journal. Save at turn 1, then record endTurn and save at turns 2 and 3.
Delete all three campaignPayloads replicas for the turn-2 generation's headDigest. Leave the turn-3 head intact.
Save the original live turn-3 journal without another command. The operation succeeds and retained generation turns become [2,3,3].

loadLatestCampaign('auto') now fails with 'No valid save remains in this slot. Import a backup.' Appending another endTurn before saving likewise succeeds, retains [2,3,4], and destroys the remaining recovery path.
logic_errors.verification: Reproduced with Node/fake-indexeddb and actual Chromium 152 IndexedDB in isolated databases.
logic_errors.required_change: Prevent destructive rotation/publication when a required prefix dependency is unreadable, or atomically reconstruct and verify the missing history from the owning journal. Preserve the last readable generation.
logic_errors.attribution: Pre-existing incremental-storage behavior, still present in the reviewed working-tree integration.

logic_errors.finding: Reference-count metadata is treated as authoritative for destructive garbage collection after checking only its recomputable checksum. Inconsistent but resealed metadata can delete intact history still needed by every remaining generation.
reproduction: Save three successive endTurn records, producing generations at turns 2, 3 and 4.
Read the oldest generation's head blob. Its refs value is 2: the generation and its successor chunk both reference it.
Change refs to 1 and recompute metadataChecksum using checksum(JSON.stringify(the metadata body)). Do not change any payload or manifest.
Loading still succeeds at turn 4. A no-op save then succeeds, rotates the oldest generation and deletes all three replicas of its still-referenced head.
Loading subsequently fails with 'No valid save remains in this slot. Import a backup.'
logic_errors.verification: Reproduced in both fake-indexeddb and actual Chromium IndexedDB.
logic_errors.scope: Requires inconsistent/resealed local IndexedDB metadata; no portable-file or remote exploit was demonstrated. This is a referential-integrity failure, not a claim that checksums provide authentication.
logic_errors.required_change: Do not reclaim payloads solely from self-checksummed reference counts without a trustworthy reachability/integrity check.
logic_errors.attribution: Pre-existing bookkeeping behavior retained by this patch.

suggestions: Add regression tests for interior dependency loss and resealed reference-count inconsistency, including append/no-op saves and preservation of the last readable generation.

Keep actual browser quota exhaustion, process-kill durability, cross-browser behavior and mobile-memory certification explicitly unverified. Injected quota exceptions and authored retained reports do not establish those guarantees.
summary: FAIL on reproduced historical-durability defects. All six postimage SHA256s matched the manifest before and after review; the diff is exactly 43263 bytes. All 81 focused tests across nine files passed with maxWorkers=2, including fresh rule-17 manual/autosave integration, historical compatibility and worker integration. Persistence lint and root typecheck passed; static scans found no listed dangerous patterns. Chromium verified surrogate-boundary roundtrip equality and concatenated-gzip rejection. Retained artifact hashes, gzip integrity and expanded byte counts matched the evidence; large full replay was not rerun. No source/docs edits were made; isolated browser test databases were deleted.
